anchors: Walk all ten for each required behaviour.
decision: An author walks the same ten numbered axes for each required behaviour and writes the variants down; a reviewer walks them from the spec.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. RED haiku: importer run 2 never mentions an upload in progress or overlapping runs. With the skill, 3 of 3 haiku runs and 2 of 2 opus runs carry a row for both.

reopen_if: A measurement on changes of real plan size shows the walk costing more than the variants it finds are worth, or shows an axis that never yields a row.
why: Without the list a haiku implementer left whole axes out in some runs (input still being uploaded and overlapping runs in 1 of 2 runs of the importer task) and nothing in its hand-over showed that they had not been looked at. A fixed list makes an unvisited axis a visible empty place.

anchors: There is no fifth, and an empty cell is the defect this skill exists for.
decision: Every variant gets exactly one of HANDLED, REFUSED, ASSUMED or NONE, each with what backs it: the line and test, the visible signal, the statement with its confirmer and consequence, or the reason the axis does not exist.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. With the skill every implementer run (haiku 6, opus 4) returned the table with a verdict in each row; several arms asked how to mark a variant served through an added condition or served in part, which the text now answers.

reopen_if: A fifth outcome turns up in practice that none of the four can carry without bending its definition.
why: The defect class is a variant nobody decided. Four verdicts that each demand a named backing leave no way to pass over a variant without writing something a reviewer can check.

anchors: Decide the fewest samples that may carry the verdict and, for a span, the widest gap
decision: A rule over a span or a share needs a decision on the fewest samples that may carry the verdict and, for a span, the widest gap between two of them.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. RED haiku 2 of 2 runs: coverage checked at the two ends only. RED opus 2 of 2 runs: anchor reading plus a maximum gap. With the skill: haiku 3 of 3 runs carry a minimum count and a maximum gap.

reopen_if: A weak-tier baseline on other span rules handles sample count and gap unprompted.
why: It is the one place the haiku baseline failed in 2 of 2 runs: both runs checked only that the readings reach within 30 s of each end of the 3 minute window, so two readings 170 s apart, both low, report a stall.

anchors: Do not carry the third state out through a new exception or a companion function
decision: A check that could not tell returns a third state where the type has room; under a fixed signature it returns the least-claiming answer, logs a warning on a change of state and leads the open questions with it. It raises no new exception and adds no companion function.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. First draft: haiku raised a new exception class from the stall check; opus added two public functions. Text with the rule: haiku 2 of 2 and opus 1 of 1 return False with a warning and an open question, no new public name.

reopen_if: A project states that callers of fixed signatures expect an exception for an undecidable state.
why: The first draft said only that no data is a third answer. A haiku arm then raised a new exception type through a function specified to return a bool that its caller polls every 10 seconds, and an opus arm added two public companion functions. Both change a contract the spec had fixed.

anchors: A refusal ends the one item or call with a result somebody
decision: A refusal ends the one item or call with a result somebody reads and lets the other items go on; an exception that stops the whole run on a variant ordinary use supplies counts as a new failure mode.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. First draft: a haiku arm raised ValueError from the acknowledge path on every call when two configured names collide, and from the summary for a shift not yet started. The reviewer arms on both tiers rated the crash paths of the planted importer high for the items left unhandled.

reopen_if: Never for unattended jobs; an interactive tool whose user reads the traceback may refuse by raising.
why: Told to refuse what they could not serve, the first-draft arms raised from inside per-item paths, which in an unattended job blocks every later item and is read by nobody.

anchors: A table read first becomes the list you check, and its gaps become yours.
decision: A reviewer builds the variant table from the spec before opening the author table or the code, and returns it with the findings.

evidence.text: Not measured: the planted review task carries no author table. Reviewer arms with the skill returned their own table on both tiers (haiku 2 runs, opus 2 runs).

reopen_if: A measurement shows reviewers finding as many missing variants when they start from the author table.
why: A table read first becomes the checklist, so the reviewer inherits exactly the variants the author did not think of.

decision: The skill text and its description claim no gain in what an opus implementer or a reviewer of either tier finds.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. RED reviewer on the planted importer: opus found every pre-registered axis, haiku every one except overlapping runs. RED opus implementer: 4 of 4 runs handled or stated the pre-registered axes, except a missing target directory on a first run in 1 run.

reopen_if: A measurement on a change of real plan size shows a gain for opus or for reviewers.
why: At the size probed they already find the variants without it: opus implementers enumerated them unprompted in 4 of 4 runs (one run left a missing target directory out), and reviewers of both tiers found the planted ones (opus all, haiku all but overlapping runs). The measured gain is on the haiku implementer and in the form of the hand-over.

decision: The skill ships alone, with no per-language companion skills.

evidence.text: Headless implementer probes, tools off, two planted tasks (a scheduled file importer; a stall check with an acknowledge command and a shift summary), one or two runs per cell. Both tasks were Python; no missed variant in any RED run traced back to a Python construct.

reopen_if: A baseline in one language shows a trap that the ten axes do not lead to and that is specific to that language.
why: The baseline failures were about what the environment supplies (sample density, a name in another form, an upload in progress), not about a construct of one language.

decision: The text takes its examples from varied everyday domains (a file importer, a payment, a scheduled job, a name index) and none from the change whose review led to the skill; the skill is not measured on that change either.

evidence.text: User decision 2026-11-26: the skill must be generic and not tailored to the task it came from.

reopen_if: Never for that change. Any other change is a valid workpiece.
why: The skill has to be useful for any required behaviour. Examples from one change would teach that change, and a measurement on it would read the answers back.
